title: Edge
description: Shared edge data contract for Flink, PyTorch Geometric, Redis, and Neo4j (tasks.md 0.2, specs.md FR5.1/FR5.2).

edge_id.description: Deterministic id (e.g. hash of src|dst|protocol|t_e) used as the Active Graph Store / Redis / Neo4j key.

dst.description: Destination node id, same id format as src.

src_type.description: Node type of src per specs.md FR5.1 (minimum: User, Machine/Host).

protocol.description: Underlying wire protocol; selects lambda_p from the Protocol Decay Registry (FR1.2).

w_0.description: Initial edge weight (severity/importance) at ingest time.

w.description: w(e,t) at last evaluation; null until first computed. Not authoritative -- recomputed on read (design.md 2.1).

w_evaluated_at.description: Wall-clock time (epoch seconds) the w field was last recomputed.

source_system.description: Ingestion adapter that produced this edge, e.g. 'sysmon', 'lanl_replay'.

raw_event_id.description: Originating log event id (e.g. Sysmon/Security Event ID) for forensic traceability.
